apply_diff_augment: apply differential augmentation to a batch of image tensors using specified augmentation types
apply_rand_brightness: apply random brightness perturbation to a batch of image tensors
apply_rand_translation: apply random spatial translation to a batch of image tensors with configurable ratio
apply_rand_cutout: apply random cutout augmentation to a batch of image tensors with configurable ratio
apply_rand_offset: apply random horizontal and vertical offset to a batch of image tensors using torch roll
